summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MsgRouter Platform MVP - backend APIs working excellently (19/20 tests passed), frontend UI functional with successful login, dashboard display, and navigation. Core CRUD operations, authentication, and data seeding all working correctly.

integration_issues.issue: Authentication session appears to reset between test runs
